title: Spotify: Recommendations, Lyrics Sync, and Caching
description: Add personalized recommendations, synchronized lyrics display, and song caching.

data.text: Extend Spotify with personalized recommendations, synchronized lyrics display, and caching popular songs to reduce CDN costs.

data.title: LyricsSync and SongCache
Why MemoryCache for songs?
data.text: Hot songs are played thousands of times per minute. MemoryCache avoids repeated CDN fetches. SizeLimit prevents memory exhaustion. Sliding expiration evicts cold songs.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: LyricsSync uses time-sorted pairs for O(log n) lookup
SongCache reduces CDN cost for popular tracks
Recommendations blend genre affinity and play count
data.takeaway: Spotify is a catalog, queue, and cache problem. Cache the hot songs, sync lyrics by time, and recommend by genre affinity.
